page.overview:
What is Achelar?

Achelar was a small town located in the nation of Halruaa during the 14 century DR.

Achelar lay in northeast Halruaa among the western foothills of the Muaraghal Mountains. The town marked a halfway point between the Nath in the north and Lake Maeru in the south.
